name: plan-mode-supplement
description: A planning-quality supplement for Codex Plan Mode on GPT-6-Astra, derived from a measured comparison against native Plan Mode.

interface.shortDescription: Raises plan quality while Codex Plan Mode is active
interface.longDescription: A 4.4k-character supplement that layers on top of Codex's native Plan Mode instead of replacing them. It adds reuse-first grounding, verification with observable pass/fail, rollback for irreversible steps, a risk statement when the user drops a safety step, and a silent adversarial review before the plan is emitted. The repository also ships the probe harness used to compare it against native Plan Mode.
defaultPrompt: Plan the change we discussed, grounded in this repository.
What would break if we skipped the regression tests here?
